queries.query:
find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d
| filter d.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and d.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter d.service_identifier is not null and d.service_identifier != ""
| filter ${project_filter_predicate} and ${service_filter_predicate}
| filter ${environment_filter_predicate} and ${env_type_filter_predicate}
| aggregate {
    d.service_name as service,
    d.project_identifier as project,
    distinct_count(d.stage_execution_id) as deployments,
    round(100.0 * count(case when d.stage_status = "SUCCESS" then 1 end) / nullif(count(), 0), 1) as success_rate,
    round(100.0 * count(case when d.stage_status in ["FAILED", "ABORTED", "EXPIRED", "APPROVAL_REJECTED", "APPROVALREJECTED", "ERRORED"] then 1 end) / nullif(count(), 0), 1) as change_failure_rate,
    median(d.stage_duration) / 1000.0 as median_lead_time,
    max(d.end_ts) as last_deployed
  }
| group_by service, project
| order_by deployments desc
| limit 50

widget.subtitle: Per-service DORA view: volume, success, failure rate, lead time and last deployment
